variant.description: Use the direct UTC date formatter for grouping, skip full timestamp formatting per input row, and format only retained extrema for final JSON.
variant.equivalence_basis: The date operation derives the same UTC calendar date directly from each parsed instant; earliest and latest timestamps retain exact microseconds and are formatted canonically for the same output fields.
variant.name: utc-date-and-compact-record
